articleTitle: Review of Advances in Smart Grids, Blackout Mitigation, and Applications in Bangladesh
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Blackout has become a significant global issue, as evident from the blackouts in India, Texas, etc. in the last few years. The power outages put at-risk businesses and factories, and the future of energy is dependent on an intelligent grid and a smart city, and our diligence in correcting those problems. This article evaluates the causes of a power outage, advancements in smart grid technologies, as well as how we might incorporate them into our day-to-day life.

articleTitle: LabVIEW Based Control and Monitoring of a Remote Test-Bench Experiment for Teaching Laboratories
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Recently, great efforts have been made to passing from traditional to online learning due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Regarding online learning, many concepts have been developed to use various learning methods in electrical engineering laboratories because this involves equipment that students have not access. To solve this problem, virtual instruments have been made to control and monitoring equipment from the laboratories. In this paper, we presented a solution for the development of a remote laboratory for measuring a DC motor speed. The greatest advantages of this method are the remote interaction of the students with the workbenches in classes, the shortening working time, the measured values accuracy, the automatic graph drawing, and reducing measurement errors.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of grid-connected rooftop solar photovoltaic systems using different photovoltaic technologies: a case study in Romania
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Solar energy is one of the most important unlimited renewable energy sources that is becoming an increasingly used alternative to generate cleaner electricity. The efficiency of solar photovoltaic technologies has improved considerably, especially in the last decade. This study investigates the performance of a 6-kW grid-connected residential rooftop photovoltaic systems that are using various photovoltaic modules technologies, namely monocrystalline silicon, polycrystalline silicon, heterojunction with intrinsic thin layer, thin film copper indium gallium selenide, cadmium telluride and amorphous silicon for a residence in Romania. The results highlight that thin film copper indium gallium selenide technology is the most suitable in terms of monthly average performance ratio, while monocrystalline silicon panel is the most appropriate option in terms of ratio between produced electricity and occupied area. The findings of this paper are valuable for the stakeholders in establishing the photovoltaic modules technologies that are suitable for the investigated location or other zones with similar climatic characteristics.

articleTitle: Determination of the Condition of Solid Insulation in High-Power Transformers Based on 2-Furfuraldehyde and Methanol Markers Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the electric substations, risk-free operation of power transformers is important, as unexpected failures and outage can result in serious accidents and lead to high costs that are undesirable in an increasingly competitive environment. The loss of the mechanical strength and the aging of oil-impregnated cellulose insulation are important factors which limit the operating life of transformers. There is a constant concern for the determination of new chemical markers and methods for identifying cellulose insulation degradation in transformers as early as possible. This paper presents the determination of the state of degradation of solid insulation in a transformer based on 2-furfuraldehyde (2-FAL) and methanol (MeOH) chemical markers by using a system based on neural networks with a Bayesian-type training algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a BLDC Motor for Small Power Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper aims to present the steps in designing of a BLDC motor for small power vehicles, in which the dimensions are imposed by adopting the direct-drive concept applied to a 12-inches wheel. The motorized small power vehicles legislation imposes a maximum power and a limited speed for certain skills in driving on the public streets. These are the initial condition in developing such kind of motors for electrical motorcycle.Using special software, the designed stage allows a parametric analysis to obtain an optimized mechanical solution and a good electromagnetic configuration of the in-wheel direct-drive motor. Skewed slot construction is adopted in the optimization process, which seems to be a good solution in the improvement of the cogging torque and also a possibility to increase the speed of the motor at low resistant torque, for this motor topology with 24 stator slots and 22 rotor permanent magnets.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic-Thermal System for Trigenerating Electricity, Hot Water and Cold
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The use of renewable energy is a priority for both European Union countries and the Republic of Moldova. The main sources of renewable energy that are used today are wind energy and solar energy excluding hydropower. The paper focuses on increasing the efficiency of solar energy use. Usually, solar energy is used in two ways: as electricity by using photovoltaic panels; as thermal energy through the use of solar collectors. Photovoltaic panels have an average efficiency of 6-20%, which means an energy loss of 80% irradiated on its surface. This thermal energy increases the temperature of the photovoltaic cells to 80 °C in summer with strong sun. Heating photovoltaic cells decreases the electrical efficiency by about 0.4% at each degree. The paper proposes an innovative technical solution to increase the efficiency of solar energy use based on photovoltaic panels. The photovoltaic panels are equipped with a cooling system based on tubular capillaries mat, which have a low cost and the integration of a water-to-water heat pump with hot water storage system. The proposed technical solution allows the realization of the trigeneration system: the simultaneous production of electricity, domestic hot water and cold. This system leads to an overall increase in the efficiency of the use of irradiated solar energy on the surface of the photovoltaic panel up to 45% and is much more competitive with the separate use of photovoltaic panels and solar collectors.

articleTitle: A New Topology of Fractional-Slot ConcentratedWound Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with Grain-Oriented Electric Steel for Stator Laminations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The race to achieving maximum efficiency and higher torque/power density in electrical machines has started long time ago and now is slowly pushing its limits. Choosing the right type of electrical machine for each application, using computer added design and optimization methods for dimensioning and building complex electric drive systems contributed to today’s performances in this field. Lately, the specialist’s attention turned to using revolutionary materials with outstanding proprieties, for electrical machines to reach higher goals; but this approach comes with additional production costs that some mass industries are not willing to pay. Instead, this paper comes with a new proposal for using grain-oriented electric steel, which is a commonly used silicon steel for electrical transformers, in fractional-slot concentrated-wound (FSCW) permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM), for performance improvement. Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is used for simulations and some preliminary conclusions are drawn.

Author Keywords: fractiona-slot concentrated-wound permanent magnet synchronous motor

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Laboratory Concept Focused on Power Electronics Units
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Distributed energy systems are gaining popularity. A growing number of research works are devoted to multi-agent systems design for the power subsystem of distributed energy systems. However, power electronics units with the use of microprocessor control systems are required to check the proposed algorithms. This study is dedicated to describing the energy laboratory concept for testing and verifying distributed power energy control algorithms based on a multi-agent approach and beta-testing the power units themselves. The power electronics units are designed and implemented for laboratory microgrid which includes a new type of small wind turbine and smart window.

articleTitle: Development of Vector Control Structures for Traction Systems with Six-Phase Asynchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Research and development of traction systems with multiphase motors, including six-phase motors becomes an efficient way to improve the performance of urban electric passenger vehicles. For this purpose, the basic components of the six-phase asynchronous motor traction system are identified and the structural elements of the power circuit of the six-phase voltage inverter are described. Also, the structure and the mathematical model of the quasi six-phase or double star motor are specified. For the same purpose, the inverter structure with two three-phase FOC-PWM control circuits, the FOC-PWM inverter structure with a single six-phase control circuit, the two-channel six-phase DTC-SVM inverter structure and the DTC-SVM inverter structure with a single six-phase control circuit are developed. The results of these activities can be used to model and simulate the six-phase motor control systems and its components, as well as to develop and test the physical models of systems.

articleTitle: A Smart FES and Mechatronic Glove System MANUTEX Aiming for Recovery of the Upper Limb in Stroke People
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents the development and the validation for an upper limb rehabilitation system for stroke patients. The system uses the functional electrical stimulation (FES) based on surface electrodes knitted into a novel textile glove. The passive mobilization is done by using an exoskeleton mechatronic system. The overall control system accounts for a balanced control between FES, mechatronic exoskeleton, and any remaining patient voluntary control. This project helps the upper limb rehabilitative process and also provides a record of the quantified improvements on a daily basis. This final design will be tested in a clinical environment aiming to help the patients with neuromuscular diseases to evaluate and train their grip force control.

articleTitle: Automation Design of a Two-Axis Control Using Sinamics S210 and S7-1511T PLC
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the world of industrial automation, PLCs are the most used types of automatic controllers and for this reason it is necessary for engineers to have the ability to develop optimized and highly complex software applications. In this paper, the authors present an automation design of a two-axis control using Sinamics S210 and S7-1511T PLC useful for master’s students in the field of electrical engineering. To provide an experience closer to real world applications and allowing the study of PLC programming, PROFINET industrial communication protocol, design screens for Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) and positioning applications, the students can use the proposed solution in the faculty laboratories. Therefore, the students can start with the development of low complexity software applications and finish by making high complexity applications.

articleTitle: Strategies, Schemes, and Algorithms of Synchronous Space-Vector PWM for Voltage Source Inverters of Open-End Winding Motor Drives: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents short review of alternative schemes, algorithms, and techniques of space-vector-oriented synchronous multi-zone pulsewidth modulation (PWM), developed and investigated for synchronous regulation of three-phase and five-phase converters of open-end winding motor systems. These strategies and techniques of synchronous multi-zone PWM applied for regulation of the corresponding converters of three-phase, five-phase and six-phase ac systems insure both improved spectral composition (without undesirable subharmonics) of basic voltages of ac systems (characterized by its continuous symmetries) and minimization of value of common mode voltage in these topologies of the analyzed drive systems.

articleTitle: Distance Measurement Method Based on Average Interpupillary Distance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents a method of measuring the distance using a video camera designed to assess the distance the user is from the camera and be exploited industrially for applications such as Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). The measurement method uses a statistically determined average interpupillary distance for both men and women and has been implemented in Python. The eye position detection was performed using the OpenCV library.

articleTitle: DBD Non-Thermal Plasma Used on Surface Treatment of Polymeric Film for Food Packaging
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The benefits of polymeric food packaging are widely recognized, but improper sterilization and disinfection of the inner surface of the polymer in contact with food can pose a major risk to food safety. On the other hand, the next generation of food packaging should be suitable for the incorporation of electronic labels and smart labels, in order to improve food traceability. The non-thermal plasma (NTP) has emerged as a technology capable of increasing the surface energy of polymers, improving adhesion and printability and has been successfully applied for surface decontamination of both food products and food packaging. This work was performed using a barrier discharge (DBD) reactor in air at atmospheric pressure to treat polyethylene terephthalate, biaxially oriented polypropylene and low-density polyethylene flat substrates for 0.3 s, 0.6 s, 1 s and 3 s. Two methods were used to obtain information on the surface of the samples used, namely by measurement of water contact angle with a goniometer by the sessile method and by determining the surface tension with Arcotest (commercial test using set of fluids with defined surface tension). The DBD treatment effect is highlighted through smaller values of water contact angles and better surface tension.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity and Feasibility of Energy Storage Systems for Power Plants Using Variable Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Nowadays, the decarbonization of the global and national economies by shifting from using fossil energy sources to using renewable energy sources represents an upward trend. The greatest potential has wind and photovoltaic sources, which are characterized by intermittency and unpredictability due to the intermittent nature of wind speed and solar irradiance. Thus, the main challenge for the integration of variable renewable energy sources (VRESs) into existing power systems is the gap between the electricity load of final users and the electricity generation of VRES. The main solutions for this challenge include using the reserve generation capacity and/or the energy storage systems (ESSs). Energy storage can be realized at different levels of the power systems: the end-users, the power plants, or the electricity grid. In this paper, we present the feasibility evaluation of the different types of ESS (battery and fuel cells) for the smoothing of the peak generation curve of the power plants using VRESs and the economically optimal capacity of ESSs.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Hybrid Water Heating System for a Swimming Pool
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In this paper the authors analyze the energy efficiency of using a combined hot water system needed for a major consumer. The system is composed of an installation with solar thermal collectors and a natural gas thermal power plant that provides the necessary hot water for a swimming and physiotherapy complex, respectively for its utilities. In the conditions of the alarming increase of thermal energy prices but also of taxes on polluting emissions (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) is investigated the possibility of using solutions for producing thermal energy from renewable sources in areas less favorable to the conversion of solar energy (northern Romania), the real environmental impact and efficiency of a such investments.

articleTitle: Evaluation upon the Energy Resources of Photovoltaic Systems depending on their Location
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The year 2020 will be remembered as a year of turbulences. Our towns have been devastated by the pandemic, but the environment benefited from the drastic reduction in fossil fuel use. Citizens and civil society pressure led the courts to push governments to enhance their own climate policies, while the private sector purchased high ever quantities of renewable energy. The results of this study are once again an argument for the decisive share that photovoltaic energy must have in the balance of the future. For the fastest possible recovery of investment in renewable sources (the so-called Energy Payback Time-EPBT parameter) but also for the effective reduction of greenhouse gas emissions (acronym GHG, mainly CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>), photovoltaic systems are one of the most sustainable and inexhaustible solutions. All despite the fact that their energy efficiency is strongly influenced by the location, having a degree of unpredictability dictated by the proverbial whims of weather. Our study is a comparative one. There are two main options for photo-voltaic (PV) systems: monocrystalline (mono-Si) and multicrystalline (multi-Si). We have chosen two different cities in Romania, a northern city (Iasi) and a southern one (Constanta). There are analyzed two essential elements: one from environmental perspective-the quantity of greenhouse gas (expressed in g of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> directly or not produced for an energy of 1 kWh) and the second mainly financial, the EPBT. Due to solar radiation and the technical solution adopted, our calculations show that CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, eq/kWh varies between 0.27 and 0.36 g range and the EPBT might varies from 1.33 to 1.54 years.

articleTitle: Modern Methods of Analysing the Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: From the practice of operation and maintenance of electrical equipment (transformers, motors and generators, etc.) it is known that, in order to ensure a safe operation and functionality, it is necessary to know, among other things, the condition of the insulation system, because about 40% of flaws which occur in operation are due to insulation flaws, in some cases can reach even close to 100% [1], [2]. Electrically insulating oils are used in high-power transformers with multiple functions: electrical insulation and cooling medium. Therefore, knowing the condition of the transformer oil can provide valuable data about its ageing status, the remaining life of the transformer, useful information in the maintenance activity. This paper proposes the presentation of modern methods and equipment for the study and analysis of physical and chemical properties (analysis of water content, density and interfacial tension) and electrical (determination of loss factor tanδ, and relative permittivity εr) of transformer oil. Samples of transformer oil type MOL TO 30.01 uninhibited electrical insulator (non-additive), new StaSo Transformer Oil I (high quality inhibited insulating oil) were studied: two samples collected directly from the original barrel, two samples collected from the transformer tank, after dielectric tests at the transformer’s manufacturer, and two samples of used TR 30 oil, collected from two transformers.

articleTitle: Comparison Between Two Brain Computer Interface Systems Aiming to Control a Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: A Brain Computer Interface (BCI) is a type of communication device between the brain and a computer system without the need of normal muscle activation pathways. This technology has offered patients with locked-in syndrome a way to communicate with the outside world. The purpose of this paper is to present the results of a comparison between two state of the art pieces of BCI equipment. One employs the active dry electrodes on a non-portable BCI system, and the second is the g.Nautilus wearable BCI device with active wet electrodes. The applications in question deal with the control of a mobile robotic platform using the Steady State Visually Evoked Potential and the Motor Imagery methods. The comparison takes into account delays in controlling the external device, the performances to collect the proper EEG signals, their treatment and extraction of the required info for the proposed control, time to prepare the required set-up etc.

articleTitle: Gas Pricing Mechanisms: Overview, Comparative Analysis and Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: With the development of natural gas trade on an international scale, pricing issues have become of serious importance for market participants. Natural gas is not a standard commodity, the main differences are that it is a natural resource, the reserves of which are unevenly distributed, and the investments in production and transportation are highly specific. This paper discusses the main gas pricing mechanisms and their use in key regions. The result of the study is the development of recommendations for the Republic of Moldova.

articleTitle: Techno-economic assessment of grid-connected residential rooftop photovoltaic systems using various photovoltaic technologies: a case study in the Northwestern Romania
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Solar energy represents one of the most encouraging renewable energy sources that is expected to gradually replace most fossil energy sources in the electricity production, contributing to climate protection throughout the world, especially by diminishing greenhouse gas emissions. The photovoltaic technologies’ energy performance has been significantly enhanced during the last decade. The deployment of grid-connected rooftop photovoltaic systems for residences in Romania is nowadays undergoing remarkable expansion. This paper analyses the techno-economic feasibility of deploying 6 kW grid-connected rooftop photovoltaic installations based on monocrystalline silicon, polycrystalline silicon, heterojunction with intrinsic thin layer, thin film copper indium gallium selenide, cadmium telluride and amorphous silicon photovoltaic technologies for a dwelling located in the Northwestern Romania. The results revealed that polycrystalline silicon photovoltaic system proved to be the most economically feasible option. This techno-economic assessment provides valuable information for different stakeholders regarding the opportunity of deploying photovoltaic installations in the examined location or for regions with comparable climate features.

articleTitle: Aspects Regarding the Heating of Electric Buses
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Heating the electric vehicles requires new challenges compared to thermal engine vehicles. Limited energy available from the traction battery needs new approaches for the heating systems and the thermal management, especially for the urban electric buses, which are operating in various and difficult conditions. The article presents the heating systems in use or tested on electric vehicles, with a proposal for an infrared heating system to be used on electric buses. An estimation of the heat flux necessary on the bus is also presented.

articleTitle: IoT based on Membrane Computing Models
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the given paper it is approached a method of the application of the Membrane Computing models in the design of IoT systems with Collective Intelligence properties. The topology of the IoT system is presented as a Mesh network that ensures a total interconnection of its devices. The Collective Intelligence definition model presents a Hopfield Neural Network based on the set of knowledge consisting of data and their processing models. The following were elaborated: cell structure, cell interaction diagram and the manner of formation of hierarchical structures and of Collective Intelligence. The synthesis process of an IoT system on the basis of Membrane Computing models with Collective Intelligence properties is presented by the sequence of operations that begins with the definition of the mathematical model and ends with the development of the structure of the IoT system on the basis of the programmable devices ESP8266.

articleTitle: A New Topology with 31-Levels for Cascaded Multilevel Inverters
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a thirty-one-level inverter topology which can be connected in a cascade fashion to generate higher levels. The topology is arranged in three sections. The left and right sections are similar in shape but contain DC sources of different magnitude while center section is an H-bridge circuit with two more switches. By appropriately designing the switching sequence, thirty-one levels are obtained. In addition, sixty-one levels are obtained by connecting two units of the proposed topology. MATLAB /Simulink simulations show that proposed topology can indeed generate the stated voltage levels.

articleTitle: Reactive Energy Transfer Reduction Equipment for Low-Load Wound-Rotor Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The power quality covers the means to conserve energy resources, such means consist in improving the power factor and judiciously managing the reactive energy in the power system. On the premise that for industrial consumers, the main consumers of reactive energy are the low-load induction motors and transformers, this paper presents a synchronization equipment (DISMAP) for a wound-rotor induction motor with a power of 2000 kW, which allows the increase of the power factor, significantly reducing the reactive energy consumption. The equipment presented was designed, built, tested and validated by tests carried out in the high-power laboratory.

articleTitle: Analysis of Romania’s Transmission Power Lines Behavior under Direct Lightning Strikes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The high voltage overhead power lines are greatly exposed to direct lightning strikes due to their significant height. In the case of direct lightning strikes in line’s elements (towers, active conductors, and ground wires) or even in the near vicinity of the line, dangerous lightning overvoltage could appear, thus conducting to the line’s insulators flashover, which can cause the line’s disconnection. In this context this paper aims to analyze the behavior of several power transmission lines of Romania’s national power system, when struck by lightning, considering the keraunic level of the areas they are passing through.

articleTitle: Typical Operating Modes of a Multichannel Frequency Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of post-emergency operating modes of a multichannel frequency converter, made on the basis of static transformer phase control devices. The results of computational experiments obtained on the structural-simulation model, which prove the possibility of providing asynchronous alternative current controlled intersystem communication (CIC) in case of emergency shutdown of several converter channels, are presented. The possibility of ensuring the qualitative characteristics of the conversion in various variants of a post-emergency situation evolution with a different number of simultaneously operating channels of the device is illustrated.

articleTitle: ESR and capacity measurement of supercapacitor banks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In this paper the techniques for measuring capacity and ESR in supercapacitor banks are presented. Modelling and simulations in LTSpice environment were performed. The effect of the sampling frequency, discharge current, electronic load used for ESR measurement is analyzed and an algorithm is proposed to improve the accuracy of the measurements. The measurement errors calculated show the effect of parameters on the measurement results.

articleTitle: Solution for Monitoring and Remote Control Based on Modbus RTU and S7-1200 PLC
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Long distance communications in the industrial environment are a challenge for the engineering phase of a project. Not always the process to be controlled is in the same location as the control room where PLC or DCS (Distributed Control System) is installed. The solution to communicate with the equipment in the field is implemented by fieldbuses that saves cables and man hours. In this paper we propose a method to monitor and remote control a water pump trough PLC-1200 from Siemens by Modbus RTU protocol. The soft starter is located 50m distance from the control room and is connected in MODBUS RTU network through CM PtP module in ET200SP configuration. The measurement of the current in Amps is displayed on an HMI from the automation system.

articleTitle: On-line Evaluation in Graphic Engineering Disciplines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The transition to on-line learning required rigors not only in the use of new technologies, but also in the organization of courses in schools and universities. It was necessary to revise the content of the course, as well as the methods of teaching and assessment. The evaluation of students in the graphic disciplines is of increased complexity. The article proposes a solution for testing students based on the cognitive levels of Bloom's Taxonomy and using the tools provided by the MOODLE platform.

articleTitle: Firefly Algorithm for Establishing the Optimal Power of DG Units
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper analyzes the impact of distributed generation (DG) energy upon the real power losses in a radial power grid. The study is applied on a standard 33-bus IEEE power grid and uses a nature-inspired metaheuristic algorithm to optimize the values and the position of an active power DG unit. Optimal network operation involves minimum values of power losses and maintaining the voltage level in the nodes within the imposed limits. The determinations were performed by associating the firefly algorithm to the calculation of power losses in the analyzed network.

articleTitle: Simulation of Filters of Six Symmetrical Components of Currents (Voltages) of Controlled Self-Compensating Power Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the paper, simulation of filters of six symmetrical components of currents (voltages) of controlled self-compensating power lines (CSCL) are done. The theoretical base and the advantages of using six symmetrical components of currents and voltages for calculating asymmetrical short circuits and relay protection of CSCL are given. The algorithm for extracting the corresponding symmetrical components from the currents and voltages between the phases of CSCL and the mathematical description and computer simulation of filters for six symmetrical components, by using MATLAB & Simulink programs, are presented.

Author Keywords: electrical lines with self compensation and controled self compensation parameters

articleTitle: Assessing Methods for Potential Induced Degradation in Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents some studies focused on a problem that has gained great importance in recent years: the so called potential induced degradation (PID) on poly-crystalline and mono-crystalline solar modules.Since the potential induced degradation on solar modules is very gradual, it is difficult to highlight or localize it, even if monitoring is daily performed by using a data logger, evaluating and comparing the results. The main reason for not recognizing the PID effect from the very beginning is the daily difference regarding the solar radiation.The five most used methods of PID detection are briefly reviewed, being identified strong points but also the limitations of each of them. The investigated methods are the following: the measurement of the current power of a module or a string, the examination of infrared radiation by means of thermography, the determination of UV fluorescence, the measurement of electroluminescence process by using special cameras and the evaluation of dark characteristics and/or bypass diode check.Furthermore, through our researches on the domain of photovoltaic systems, we were able to recognize that PID on solar power modules appeared more in wet weather and rain over a longer period of time than during rather dry weather periods. It indicates that PID is more recognizable after the autumn and winter period than after summer months.Finally it is proposed a regeneration of PID by generating reverse currents at night.

articleTitle: Harmonics of the Central Component of the PWM Inverter Output Voltage
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Considering the output voltage of the PWM inverter from the photovoltaic power plants structure, as being formed by the superposition between a step type alternative voltage, centered in the middle of the alternation and several voltages as pairs of alternative unitary steps, symmetrical related to the central step, proved to be suitable for the analytical treatment of the control and harmonics problems. Thus, the identification of the Fourier series for the centered step type component allowed the application of optimal criteria leading to the determination of the conduction angles, corresponding to them. The analytical expression of the general harmonic, for the Fourier series, is validated through the graphical representations of the centered step component, analytically recomposed for different numbers of harmonics taken into account. A complete analysis of the harmonics is then carried out, extending the calculation to all the indicators considered for an alternating current wave.

articleTitle: Anaerobic - aerobic WWTP for a non-alcoholic liquid products factory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In this paper, the problem was the realization of the control philosophy and implementation of programmable distributed electromechanical systems for wastewater treatment processes. According to the legislation, most companies have imposed some parameters, of wastewater, which leaves the factory after going through the technological process. The main problem is to maintain the pH in the water between 6.5 and 7. To maintain the pH, mechanical, aerobic, anaerobic and chemical treatment methods are used. With the help of the current treatment methods used in the station, the water finally has the technical parameters that correspond to those imposed by the legislation.

articleTitle: The Influence of Renewable Energy Ratio and Conversion Factors on the Energy Performance of Buildings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents an analysis of the influence of renewable energy ratio and primary energy conversion factors on the energy performance of buildings and the fulfillment of the nearly zero energy building (nZEB) criterion. A case study is provided with reference to individual residential buildings. Considering the recent liberalization of the electricity market for household consumers and the possibility of purchasing renewable energy from the competitive market, this analysis shows the need to take into account the renewable energy purchased from the national power system.

articleTitle: Investigation of Supply Phase Failure in Phase-Shifting Transformer with Hexagon Scheme and Regulating Autotransformer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The scope of the work was the study of the phase failure operating for the new FACT’s type phase-shifting device, intended for the flexible connection of AC power systems. The mathematical model has been developed for conducting this study. The device contains the main phase-shifting transformer based on hexagon circuit with additional regulating autotransformer, this creates the possibility of circular regulation of phase shift angle between connected systems. The model includes two 6-winding three-legs transformers, for which two sets of parameters can be independently set based on the data for the short circuit and no-load modes. The data for the direct sequence parameters is usually provided by the transformer manufacturers, and the data for the zero sequence parameters could be obtained upon additional request. As a result of modeling, the vectors of the voltages and currents were obtained in all windings in the investigated modes with supply source phase failure. This makes it possible to analyze the admissibility of such modes and estimate the need for taking special measures of protection against them. It is shown that the voltages on the windings of the main transformer insignificantly depend on the connection mode of the regulating autotransformer, while the pattern of currents distribution in the windings of the main and regulating transformers to a large extent is determined by said connection mode of the autotransformer. The presence of perceptible zero-sequence current flowing through the grounded neutrals of the power supply source and load is noticed. This fact is connected with the release of insignificant magnetic flux from the magnetic circuit in the surrounding space.

articleTitle: Harmonic Decomposition and Power Quality Analysis of a Six-Phase Induction Motor Traction Drive with Fast Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of harmonic decomposition and power quality analysis of a six-phase asynchronous motor drive model designed for traction systems, by the Fast Fourier Transform tool. The six-phase asynchronous motor is fed by a Voltage Source Inverter. The goal is to determine whether the proposed 6-phase traction system is viable to prototype and test from the standpoint of power quality and electromagnetic compatibility. The resulting power quality distortion by harmonics suggest that the proposed traction system generates acceptable distortions, through but for which the accepted FFT analysis, in the IEEE Standards 1459-2010 and 519-2014, is not an efficient tool for analysis of highly dynamic traction systems. For a good representation of power distortions, a different standard should be developed and employed

articleTitle: Theories about Mechanical Calculus in the Context of Coexistence between Overhead Power Lines and Buildings from Outskirts of Cities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper is based on the authors' expertise and scientific research into the coexistence operating of the buildings located in the outskirts of cities near high voltage (HV) power lines. The coexistence study is a technical-economical document in which the overhead lines' mechanical and/or electrical assumptions are defined based on inspections, calculations, measurements, and other methods. Considering the accelerated development of cities nearly the HV power infrastructure, the paper presents the authors expertise based on mechanical calculus about the safety operation of buildings in the coexistence with the overhead power lines. These theories are validated by the results for a real study case.

articleTitle: CAE Optimization of Synchronous Reluctance Motor and Vibro-Acoustic Analysis for Lift Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The aim of this study is to evaluate the potential of Synchronous Reluctance Motors for lift systems, by also considering the vibro-acoustic behaviour of the motor. Two types of synchronous machines are here designed, analysed and compared with an equivalent induction motor, which is the more common solution in such gearbox applications. The machine performance are further improved with optimization procedures based on a Multiobjectives Optimization Genetic Algorithm (MOGA). The difference between the two types of synchronous motors consists in the rotor geometry: a symmetric and an asymmetric rotor design were investigated. The evaluation of the vibro-acoustic performance has been conducted with a multi-variable model and finite element software taking into account electromagnetic, mechanical and thermal features of the motor, therefore carrying out a multi-physics analysis of the electrical machine

articleTitle: A Survey of Condition Monitoring Systems Operation in Romanian Transmission Substations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This study presents a new methodology for monitoring system to detect in time the change of the internal state of the electrical equipment in operation, which results in the prevention of catastrophic defects, optimization of maintenance, extended life, better use of the installations. By monitoring, repairs can be postponed or they can be planned for an advantageous period. A case study in which this methodology is applied is presented and several comparisons are made in order to demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: The influence of battery state of charge on self consumption indices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Photovoltaic systems have become more accessible financially as well as legislatively, so more and more residential customers choose to use them in the production of electricity. One of the most important aspects to consider in their design and exploitation is the self-consumption indices, it restores the percentage of energy that is used in its own consumption directly from the energy produced by the photovoltaic system. It can be improved by a number of methods, including storage in battery systems.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of electromagnetic absorption properties of nano-structured composites in the radio frequency/micowave range
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Calculation and numerical electromagnetic methods allow the use of electromagnetic simulation as a method of accurate investigation of low-loss materials. Determining the parameters by simulation using CST 2011 software and applying the NRW procedure in order to investigate the material characteristics was performed on the HDPE polymer matrix that hosted Fe, Al, Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> inserts, and the SAR results depending on frequency showed differences in case the use of Fe or dielectric TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> metal particles.

articleTitle: Equalizing Links on DC Machine Windings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the design and construction of Direct Current (DC) windings, depending on the number of slots, number of pole pairs, and on the type of winding we find same potential points. To correct for the execution imperfections between same potential points, equipotential connections are provided, depending on the type of winding. There are situations where same potential points are not physically accessible, being placed in slots or on different frontal parts. Connection equipotential points is done by means of connections placed in holes made in the magnetic rotor core, such that no electromotive voltages are induced. This makes the design of the magnetic rotor core more complex and can lead to asymmetries in the machine. The work presented in this paper proposes the use of equalizer links between different potential points. In these links, which are placed in suitable slots, electromotive voltages are induced. These voltages must compensate for the difference between the winding points they are applied to. The use of the equations presented here must result into an as small as possible drop in the relative voltage between the connected points, while the number of elementary coils should be an integer multiple of the equalizing links.

articleTitle: System for Monitoring Vital Biopotentials
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: As the fundamental element that determines the well-being of each individual, health has become a growing cause of awareness and concern nowadays, as most people put more emphasis on daily activities to the detriment of health-care. In this paper, such a care system has been created and designed, allowing patients to daily store some vital parameters and transmit them through the cloud or in emergencies through mobile networks: in the form of a direct text message to the doctor's emergency number. A set of three parameters can be monitored: pulse, oxygen saturation in the blood and electrical activity of the heart which is known in literature as ECG. There is also a GPS module to determine the exact location, these being interfaced with an Arduino Mega development board. Vital parameters can be viewed on both the device and a laptop in order to download the recording history.

articleTitle: Real-Time Model Predictive Control with Online State Estimator for Series Fans Processes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: in this paper, a model predictive control strategy with an online state estimator was presented to solve the control problem for the most common industrial applications, series multiple fans systems. The online state estimator has been added to decrease the mismatch between the identified model in the offline stage and the real system model which occurred during the variation in operational conditions. The software interface and main control program of the presented experimental study is designed by the LabVIEW software. The data acquisition hardware utilized in this work is the National Instruments USB-6008 multifunction I/O device, which connects to the PC through USB.

articleTitle: Autonomous and Electrical Vehicles Development using Optimized Processes Defined by Cyber Security and Safety Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The current trend in automotive is to develop electrical and autonomous vehicles (EV&AV). The paper presents an original concept which can be used to develop AV&EV, but the same concept can be used also for "classical vehicles". The work paper begins with a brief review on the evolution of safety and cyber security standards applicable in the automotive industry. Most of the players in the automotive market do not have dedicated processes for safety and for cybersecurity. The authors propose a list of processes developed based on ISO 26262[1] and ISO/SAE 21434[2] requirements. Beside this proposal they are coming with an innovative concept which is coming into one integrated system called CSSMS (Cybersecurity and Safety Management System). This concept has as main purpose the reduction of time and resources used for development but also the fulfillment of all the requirements of the standards. In the end the concept proposed is partially validated using a steering product and proposes some steps for validating the entire system.

articleTitle: Ph.D. Research, Component of the Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Ph.D. Research is, certainly, a component of engineering education because it produces effects irrespective of the historical period in which it was carried out and of the Ph.D. candidate’s age. In order to support this information, we will present in detail some case studies in Ph.D. theses defended between 1970-2019, carried out by the Ph.D. candidates in the first 5-7 years of activity after graduating or by the Ph.D. candidates who have a lot of professional activity.Common elements of these case studies, which allow a comparative analysis, refer to the fact that all started from solving a problem required by practice, and the solutions were checked by carrying out experiments on real models at a reduced scale.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Sensitivity of the Active Power Losses in Relation to the Bus Powers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the context of the depletion of energy resources based on the fossil fuels, the transition to the renewable energy sources is inevitable. In order to minimize the power and the energy losses, it is technically and economically efficient to connect these sources to the distribution networks directly in the vicinity of electrical loads, being called distributed generation sources. It is very important to establish the optimal buses for connecting these sources.

articleTitle: Distance measurement using the sound card of a computer and two microphones
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In almost all engineering fields, distance measurement is an ongoing concern. If some time ago, in the context of technological development beginning, it was sufficient to estimate the distances, with the technological evolution, it was necessary to identify new methods for measuring distances or improving them. Thus, one of the defining methods for the days we live in is the acoustic method, which involves the transmission of sound waves and their reception, the distance being calculated according to the propagation of the sound speed through the air, but also the time passed between the transmitted and received signals. In this article, we set out to study some situations with the interference caused by various objects around our receivers, but also to take data and analyze them, to see if we can generate a new method for calculating distances. Finally, after all these studies, we are prepared to take one step forward for a new study that involves the analysis on wavelength numbers of the transmitted signal, which falls within the distance between the sensors, followed by an evaluation of the phase shift.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Power Grid Performance by Integrating Wind Turbines Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The wind power generating systems integrated in Baghdad area are presented. The power control factors are discussed. The speed control factors are presented, correlated to electric generators types. A small grid prototype in the city of Baghdad, with a voltage of 11 kV, was selected. The system of wind turbines consists of five turbines, each of them having a power of up to 1 MW. The system performances were analyzed with Forward-Backward power flow method. The integration of renewable resources into grid system was analyzed considering two cases: without and with an electronic device interface (back to back converter). The voltage profile improvement and power losses decreasing when the wind turbines system is integrated into the grid through electronic controller system are presented as conclusions.

articleTitle: Development of Powertrain System Model for Urban Passenger Vehicle Simulations
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper refers to the powertrain systems in urban electric passenger vehicles. The purpose of the work is to develop a model of a powertrain system of an electric passenger vehicle. The objective of this paper is to create mathematical and simulation models of the powertrain system, which are used to analyze the performance of the six-phase induction motor with fuzzy logic vector controller developed in previous studies. The analyses method use the simulation modeling of the electric vehicle powertrain and performance analyses during a standard driving cycle with the graphical representation of the result. Simulations show that the model can use different driving cycle profiles, consider all external forces, and provide all necessary data, such as the velocity of the electric bus together with the slip of the driving wheels for further controller tunning to overcome the override in resulting speed.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Efficiency Indicators in the Economies of European Countries
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This study includes an analysis of resource and energy productivity indicators over ten years. Through these indicators it was possible to obtain the evolution of these indicators during the years studied as well as the differences between countries because of the achievements in those economies. The comparative analysis of the two indicators shows that the evolution trend is similar during 2019. Subsequently, a ranking of countries was made according to 5 indicators: Energy productivity, Resource productivity, Greenhouse gas emissions per capita and Eco innovation index. According to this ranking, it can be seen which are the countries that registered high values for the productivity and eco-innovation indicators and countries where the Greenhouse gas emissions per capita indicator registered decreasing values.

articleTitle: Dielectric Properties of Malleable Composite Materials in Electromagnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The article relates to the realization of a new concept of malleable in the electromagnetic field thermoplastic composite materials. The object of the article is to provide the description of new types of composite materials which can be heated in an electromagnetic field and brought to an optimum temperature for mechanical processing by plastic deformation, as well as to perform some tests and analyze the influence of some material components on dielectric properties of malleable composite materials.

articleTitle: Design of the nano / micro scale structure of nanostructured composites activable in the radio frequency/microwave range depending on the frequency of the electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: For the prediction of electromagnetic performance by correlating the electromagnetic absorption properties with the structure, architecture and composition of nano-structured composites, simulations were performed for different combinations of substrate, inserts, mass density and particle size. CST software, designed for electromagnetic analysis and design in the high frequency domain, simplifies the process of creating the structure by using a solid graphical modeling that is based on the ACIS geometric modeling core. The article followed the influence of particle size by determining the variation of the relative total specific absorption rate by comparing the size of the inserts and the substrate used. At the same time, the influence of mass concentration on the variation of the relative total specific absorption rate was analyzed, respectively on the evolution of the ratio between the maximum specific absorption rate and the specific absorption rate.

articleTitle: Automated Sorting and Handling Process
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Automated sorting and handling processes aims at both reducing human errors, which affect the quality of the process, and reducing processing times. In addition to the main objective, increasing productivity, the following objectives were considered: inspecting the pallets, sorting the pallets according to the established criteria, and handling them in predetermined areas. By integrating an Omron FZ4 video camera, object inspection and data transfer were performed. The algorithm of command and control of the sorting and handling process has been done in the IndraWorks Engineering software and the HMI has been done in the WinStudio software.

articleTitle: Shaking Table on One Axis with Electrodynamic Actuator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper refers to a shaking table on a single axis designed to test the acceleration sensors used in the evaluation of seismic waves. Studying P waves in order to evaluate the intensity of S waves is a continuous challenge in the field of earthquake research and requires expensive equipment to perform seismic wave simulation, such as shaking table. In this context, it is presented the realization of a shaking table actuated by an electrodynamic actuator of diffuser type controlled by means of a power amplifier. The seismic wave configuration is transmitted to the amplifier via SCPI commands on a computer running a LabVIEW application.

articleTitle: Using A* Algorithm for Autonomous Taxi Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The present paper presents an implementation of the A* algorithm inside of an autonomous taxi application. The taxis are considered autonomous cars that have the task of picking up a customer from a point on the map and transporting him to a destination. The developed application allows the user to enter a number of depots, the number of taxis and the number of customers. Next, the application transmits the coordinates of a waiting customer to the first available taxi. The generation of the check-in and arrival locations of the clients is done in a random way. In this phase, no algorithm is implemented in order to improve the order of customer taking over, the customers being taken in the order in which the check-in is generated, and the taxis are allocated as they are released.

articleTitle: A New Topology For Cascaded Multi-Level Inverter With Symmetrical Extension of H-Bridge
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents a new topology for use in cascaded multilevel inverters. The proposed topology is generated with the addition of two symmetric units across the standard three level H-Bridge inverter. This arrangement, in combination with appropriate switching sequence, can provide thirteen levels. By cascading proposed units, a higher number of voltage levels can be achieved. Universal pulse width modulation strategy is implemented to control the output voltage of the proposed multilevel inverter. To validate the proposal, simulations are conducted in MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Identification of the Phenomena Leading to the Aging of the Insulation of In-Service High Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The study presented in this paper aims to identify the phenomena leading to the aging of the insulation of in-service high power transformers, in view of adopting optimal solutions to keep them in running. The phenomena analyzed in this paper are largely caused by the inrush current that occurs at the energization of the transformer, which led to the generation of electric arc and also to the appearance of gases dissolved in the transformer oil. The analysis of dissolved gases in oil (DGA) sampled from a 440-MVA in-service transformer was performed, using the Duval Pentagons 1 and 2, which provide additional information that can help identify various types of failures, especially if their nature is different. The results obtained from the DGA analysis led to the identification of thermal faults caused by electric discharges both inside the transformer, and outside it. The technical inspection carried out after the DGA analysis led to the validation of the analysis; there were traces of these electric discharges. Technical solutions have been proposed to avoid overheating of the transformer insulation and the occurrence of electric discharges.

articleTitle: Study of the Circulation of Heat Transfer Fluid in the Permanent Magnets Thermo-Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: the variation of the heat transfer fluid temperature in the permanent magnet thermogenerator was studied. SOLIDWORKS Flow Simulation software is used for the simulations and the dependence of the liquid temperature in the discharge line of the thermogenerator has been determined as a function of the flow at an imposed temperature of the internal and external sleeves of the thermogenerator of 60° C. Based on the simulation results, the characteristics for various construction models were analyzed in order to streamline the conversion of wind energy into heat.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic System for Corporate Sustainability Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Sustainability is a many–sided concept and has become a critical issue for corporations’ development, due to the interaction with the environment they operate in. The purpose of this research is to present an approach based on fuzzy logic in order to assess and consequently improve the corporate sustainability management. The fuzzy system underlying this approach is used to assess the corporate sustainable performance of a representative European automotive company. The research takes into account the influence of corporate environmental performance and corporate financial performance on the corporate sustainable performance. Research results indicate that the fuzzy model represents a suitable tool to provide a comprehensive analysis on the corporate sustainable performance based on environmental and financial components. The connection between corporate environmental performance and corporate financial performance by the instrumentality of fuzzy logic proves to be an innovative approach for corporate sustainable performance.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis in the Field of Polymeric Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Polymeric motors are one of the focus research points in the present due to the continuous need to obtain more performant and actualized devices. This review presents the actual trends on the polymeric motors using bibliometric networks. The paper presents a state of the articles in the introduction with the identified motor type, main objective, applications and used polymers. Analyzing the bibliometric networks, 91 main items were identified and a few of them: polymeric motor, ultrasonic motor, system, mechanism, characteristic and application. They were distributed on clusters and multiple visualization perspectives can be identified in the results section. The most important steps in building a polymeric motor are to establish the system the motor will work in, then to identify the appropriate polymer type to be compatible with the action that the motor needs to effectuate and to establish the characteristics that need to be improved comparatively with previews created motors.

articleTitle: Web Page for Data Acquisition by Accessing Local Computer Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper presents a web application for collecting medical data both by manual input and by bidirectional communication between the web server and medical devices connected to the USB port of the local computer. Web pages run in the browser and do not have access to local computer resources such as USB ports. This problem is solved by developing a windows service (which has access to the USB port) and which exposes a local web server (http://localhost:5000) that can be accessed via Ajax from the page running in the browser. Bidirectional communication between the browser and the public web server is implemented through SignalR technology.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic Efficiency Numerical Estimation of 1 kW horizontal axis wind turbine rotor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents an estimated analysis of the aerodynamic performance of a wind rotor with a horizontal axis. It is a design stage of a low power wind turbine, ≈ 1 kW. Several airfoils are considered to indicate high performance at low Reynolds numbers (approx. 100,000). For the analysis of the performance of the wind turbine with horizontal axis, the geometric parameters for a rotor with a power of 1 kW were considered. The required geometric parameters were estimated using a calculation model developed in the MathCad application. The wind rotor was developed and simulated in the QBlade application then, for comparison, it was numerically analyzed in ANSYS Fluent. The parameter of interest is the power coefficient without considering the mechanical/electrical losses and was compared with performance of some existing rotors.

articleTitle: The Design and Analysis of a Control Circuit of the Offset from the Voltage Zero Crossing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: For testing purposes or even for to reduce the transient regime when connect the equipment to the power network it is conveyable to detect zero-crossing voltage. The designed circuit use conventional electronic components to perform a zero crossing detection and give appropriate output signal to be used. Using this device has possibilities to analyze the effects of connecting in different moments of time of switching elements. This can be a part of complex test equipment to have adjusting possibilities of zero-crossing point offset. Importance of using zero-crossing device is about the transient regime, most often causes power network instability or a process of degradation of switching apparatus. Even if the detection of voltage crossing is easy to achieve with a small number of components, to achieve an adjustment of the time difference shifted from zero-crossing point required the design of a complex schematics. This circuit provides pulses at the same time towards the zero-crossing of voltage.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Control Unit for a Solar Heating System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper presents a control unit for solar water heaters. It is a solution suitable for projects with different grades of complexity, due to the basic principles described below; it can be easily scaled and configured. It uses Raspberry Pi unit for controlling the components and NodeRed for configuration.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the PID Control Algorithm for the Models of Objects with Second Order Astatism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In the paper is highlighted the industrial objects as cars, spacecraft, telescopes, plotters, lasers, elevators, etc., which are described by the mathematical model with double astatism. These models of control objects have a double pole in the origin of the coordinate axes. In order to tune the PID controller to the model of object with double astatism, it was elaborated the tuning algorithm based on the maximum stability degree method with iterations. It was done the computer simulation of the automatic control system with the respectively model of object and PID controller and it was done the analysis of the obtained performance. The advantages of the maximum stability degree method with iterations were highlighted by the reducing calculations and time, which lead to the procedure simplification of the PID controller tuning.

Author Keywords: model of the control object with double astatism
the maximum stability degree method with iterations

articleTitle: A Hybrid Charging System Design for Electric Vehicles with Autonomous Power Source
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The paper focuses on the development of hybrid battery charging systems for autonomous electric passenger vehicles. Aspects of elaboration and design methodology of the battery charging station are approached both from the three-phase electrical network, but also from a photovoltaic plant. A new structure of the battery charging station with power supply from a photovoltaic plant parallel to the public electricity grid was developed. The photovoltaic plant was dimensioned and the amount of electricity produced and consumed at the charging station was estimated. The excess of energy generated by the photovoltaic plant can be injected into the grid or, in offGrid mode, stored in buffer batteries.

articleTitle: Perspectives on Railway Electric Traction System Improvement Brought by Monitoring the Impedance Bonds
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: After a short history about the beginnings of the railway electric traction systems, in the paper are presented the elements that have an interest in being monitored for the railway electric traction power system in single-phase alternating current with the frequency of 50 Hz and voltage 25 kV, specific to the railway electric traction in Romania. The return traction current at the source is assure by the return circuit that incorporates the impedance bonds, called joint coils in Romania. Also, the paper highlights the benefit of monitoring the impedance bonds of the railway electric traction power supply system. The benefits of monitoring the joint coils from electric traction consist of currents real-time surveillance through the impedance bond’s primary windings, by knowing the temperatures of: terminals, the connection wires, on the impedance bond case and the ambient, respectively of the oil level (for classic impedance bonds). Knowing the technical condition of the impedance bond helps to make preventive maintenance work more efficient, reduce downtime and optimize the use of maintenance resources.

articleTitle: An Overview on Nonvolatile Memories Used in Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: This paper is presenting a brief comparison between two of the most used nonvolatile memories (NVM) from automotive industry. Advantages and disadvantages are presented for each one but also a critical scenario for the flash EEPROM (electronically-erasable programmable read-only memory) emulation memory with repetitive undervoltage situation.

articleTitle: Testing Stand Using Hardware Description Languages
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: HDL (Hardware Description Languages) is really important tool for all digital designers. After they have learned about Verilog or VHDL (the abbreviation for Very High Speed Integrated Circuit Hardware Description Language) System, digital designers will be capable to detail digital systems much quicker than if they would have to create all entire schematics. The HDLs are used for simulation and synthesis. It is very important to involve students passionate about digital design to use such modern languages because they can use them successfully in their future career. This paper aims to present an HDL-based test stand that can be implemented using a Nexys2 circuit board which is a complete, ready-to-use circuit development platform based on a Xilinx Spartan 3E FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array). The Nexys2 board incorporates several input devices, output devices, and data ports, allowing various designs to be implemented with no need for any other components. Basically, the test stand will offer the possibility to choose the number of inputs (three or four) and to establish six basic functions that can be selected for verification, the result being displayed using the BCD (Binary Coded Decimal) display system integrated in the board. The inputs will be represented by the set of push buttons available on the board.

articleTitle: Optimal PMU Placement and Algorithms’ Development of Accelerated Calculations of State Estimation Performance in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: Reducing the cost of implementing phasor measurement units (PMUs) can be achieved by determining the minimum number of devices needed to provide the electrical network observability. This article describes the optimal PMU placement algorithm, based on the analysis of the topological properties of the electrical network. It was shown that the optimal placement of PMUs can be achieved by dividing the nodal admittance matrix into four submatrices, one of them will be a band submatrix, which can be reduced to a lower triangular matrix of maximum rank by elementary transformations. Results reflecting the number of installed PMUs were obtained for IEEE test bus systems with 9, 14, 19, 30 and 57 nodes. For all test bus systems, the proposed PMU placement algorithm provides complete observability of the system with the same or fewer nodes of installation in comparison with the results of other authors. There were carried out computations with the help of the algorithm accelerated calculations of state estimation performance in power systems, in order to confirm the correctness of this approach. There were determined conditions under which the equations of nodal voltages were solved linearly and nonlinearly (iteratively).

articleTitle: Synthesis of the Control Algorithm to the Models of Objects with Inertia First Order and Second Order Astatism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: In this paper it is proposed to synthesize the control algorithm for the models of objects with inertia and second order astatism, which are described the dynamics of various technical objects and technological processes. These models of control objects have the double pole in the origin of axes and one negative pole. In order to tune the PID control algorithm to the given model of object, it was designed the control algorithm based on the maximum stability degree method with iterations. To verify the obtained results of tuning the PID controller, it was done the synthesis of the control algorithm by the polynomial equations method. An example of a system with the respectively model of control object and the controller synthesized according to these methods was computer simulated in the MATLAB software package and it was done the analysis of the system performance. There are highlighted the advantages of the maximum stability degree method with iterations by the simplification of the tuning procedure of the PID controller to this model of object.

Author Keywords: model of object with inertia and second order astatism
the maximum stability degree method with iterations

articleTitle: Retrospective analysis of the evolution of industrial production in relation to energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Electromechanical and Energy Systems (SIELMEN)
abstract: The study allows to know the evolution, for ten years, of the production in industry and of the energy consumption for the 27 countries of the EU. A comparative analysis was performed in which it can be seen how each country evolved, then the countries where the increase of production determined the increase of energy consumption were established, but also the countries where this connection is not direct.
